description:
SUMMARY  ***Chain-Free Living at Endeavour Court***
Discover this exceptional, light-filled first-floor apartment offering modern open-plan living, a private balcony, two bedrooms, an en-suite, and the rare bonus of allocated parking plus a private garage with built-in secure storage. Ideally positioned near local amenities and transport links, this stylish and versatile home is ready for you to move straight in-early viewing is highly recommended! 

LOCATION  Positioned within a conservation-adjacent community, Endeavour Court offers the ideal balance of tranquility and accessibility. It sits just a short walk from vibrant Stoke Village and Millbridge, which offer a selection of independent shops, cafes, local pubs, and everyday conveniences. The location also enjoys close proximity to local parks including Victoria Park, Devonport Park, and Block House Park. Excellent local schooling options are nearby, including Stoke Damerel Primary Academy and Devonport High School for Boys, alongside Devonport railway station, regular bus routes, and straightforward access into Plymouth City Centre, the waterfront, and the Royal William Yard. 

DESCRIPTION  The property is accessed via a secure communal entry system, with a private front door opening into a spacious hallway featuring two generous storage cupboards and providing access to all primary rooms.
At the heart of the home is an impressive, light-filled open-plan living, kitchen, and dining area designed for modern living and entertaining. French doors from the lounge open onto a private balcony, seamlessly extending the living space and flooding the room with natural light. The kitchen is well-appointed with a comprehensive range of wall and base units, complementary work surfaces, and tiled splashbacks. Integrated appliances include an oven, gas hob, and extractor hood, alongside plumbing for a washing machine and space for an American-style fridge-freezer, while a feature peninsula unit provides additional workspace and an informal breakfast bar.
The accommodation further comprises a well-proportioned principal bedroom with a uPVC double-glazed window overlooking the rear elevation and a private en-suite shower room. A second versatile bedroom-ideal as a guest room, nursery, or dedicated home office-also overlooks the rear, and is complemented by a modern family bathroom comprising a panelled bath, pedestal wash hand basin, and low-level WC.
Externally, the property benefits from an allocated parking space and a private single garage located to the rear of the development. The garage further features an integrated lockable storage unit, offering excellent additional secure storage.
Combining comfort, practicality, and convenience, early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality of accommodation on offer. 

VIEWINGS  Interested applicants should call Martin & Co (Plymouth) today on   in order to arrange their viewing appointment. 

NOTICE TO APPLICANTS  We endeavour to make our sales particulars accurate and reliable, however, they do not constitute or form part of an offer or any contract and none is to be relied upon as statements of representation or fact. Any services, systems and appliances listed in this specification have not been tested by us and no guarantee as to their operating ability or efficiency is given. All measurements have been taken as a guide to prospective buyers only, and are not precise. Please be advised that some of the particulars may be awaiting vendor approval. If you require clarification or further information on any points, please contact us, especially if you are traveling some distance to view. Fixtures and fittings other than those mentioned are to be agreed with the seller. We routinely refer potential purchasers to Simply conveyancing. It is your decision whether you choose to deal with Simply. In making that decision, you should know that we receive an annual payments benefits, equating to approximately £200 per referral.
